issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'vayit'abel al b'no kol hayamim' — 'and he mourned for his son all the days.' The subject is Absalom (he mourned for his son), but the Vietnamese renders 'Vua Đa-vít than khóc con trai mình' — 'King David mourned for his son,' changing the subject from Absalom to David. This is a wrong person/subject that changes who is doing the mourning.
